rubric_items.reason: All seven acceptance criteria map to REQ-1..REQ-12; column placement and filter labels are decided via A-01/A-02; out-of-scope items have reasons.
Most REQs are atomic and checkable; REQ-12 merges AC6's status-filter behaviour with AC7's 'rest unchanged' into one requirement.
Statuses are cited to ticket lines or IDE answers; C7 and the 'Today count' in REQ-12 rest on the skill's own question text rather than a product-code cite.
No clash with goals, constraints or booking rules found; the ticket-vs-product gap (Today column) was raised and answered in A-01.
Two precise questions with real options, both answered by an engineer; no needless blocking questions remain.
Plain and readable; minor overlap between REQ-4 and REQ-14 and 'Today count' vs 'Today column' wording.

findings.text: REQ-12 is compound: it merges 'status filter works as before' (AC6) with 'rest of the doctor list is unchanged' (AC7), two separately testable behaviours.

cites.quote: and the rest of the doctor list (columns, search, filters, Today count) is unchanged
Inactive doctors show their weekdays too; the status filter works as before.
7. The rest of the doctor list is unchanged.

findings.suggested_fix: Split REQ-12 into one REQ for the status filter behaving as before and one for the rest of the doctor list being unchanged.

findings.text: C7 (existing Today column) is cited to A-01, but that fact is the skill's own question text; the user only chose a position. REQ-12 also names 'Today count' citing only ticket lines, which never mention Today.

cites.quote: The doctor list already has a `Today` column after Status.
(added by HMS-6; the ticket doesn't mention it)

findings.suggested_fix: Cite the product code or PRD line that shows the Today column for C7, add that cite to REQ-12, and use 'Today column' consistently.

findings.text: REQ-4 and REQ-14 both specify the filter options ('Any day' plus Monday to Sunday); the overlap makes it unclear which REQ a test for option labels traces to.

cites.quote: new filter with "Any day" or one weekday, Monday to Sunday
REQ-14 Filter options use full weekday names (known)

findings.suggested_fix: Keep REQ-4 to the existence of the filter and its choices, and leave label wording to REQ-14.
